svg.title: Row-wise embedding lookup: key data flow across four ranks
svg.desc: Each rank starts with one feature-major tensor. Bucketize produces destination-rank-major send segments. AllToAll places each source segment at its owner rank. A final permutation groups keys by feature. Orange means Table A, cyan means Table B. Digits are owner ranks, not actual key IDs. All 40 keys are conserved. Outlined cells are the lengths tensor: one key count per rank segment and feature. The counts rise as keys land in the send buffer, and the send splits appear once they are complete. AllToAll then runs as three calls: every splits entry travels to its peer, the receiver allocates its buffers from them, the lengths cells follow, and the keys go last. The final permutation moves lengths cells together with the keys. The closing overview fills all four layouts at once.
svg.text: Filled cell number = owner rank, not key ID
Dashed route = same-rank segment · 40 keys → 40 keys
